name: uv
description: Astral's Python package and project manager (uv and uvx), installed with the official uv installer.
install: mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh -o "$t" && UV_INSTALL_DIR={{prefix}}/bin UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh "$t"; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
upgrade: mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh -o "$t" && UV_INSTALL_DIR={{prefix}}/bin UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh "$t"; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
